rows.title: Escape must return focus to the button that opened the dialog
Escape in a nested menubar submenu must close only that submenu and return focus to its parent item
An open disclosure-navigation dropdown must close when keyboard focus moves out of the navigation
The combobox's aria-activedescendant must reference the highlighted suggestion element
Enter must choose the suggestion that is highlighted after the search is refined
One Tab press must move from an autocomplete field with open suggestions to the next form field
Escape must close the dropdown menu and return focus to its toggle button
Escape on a closed dropdown toggle inside a modal must close the modal
Shift+Tab from the first control in a modal must wrap to the modal's last control
An offcanvas panel opened with a backdrop must keep keyboard focus inside the panel
A non-modal offcanvas panel that allows page scrolling must not trap keyboard focus
Arrow keys in a tab list must move keyboard focus to the newly selected tab
Arrow keys in a tab list must skip disabled tabs
When a list row containing the focused button is removed inside a focus trap, focus must stay inside the trap
When the focused control inside a focus trap removes itself, focus must stay inside the trap
Typing past a character limit must keep the text and say how many characters are too many
Header navigation links that are visible on a desktop-width page must not be hidden from screen readers
Moving to a radio in another group with the same name must hide the conditional question that no longer applies
The up and down arrow keys must not switch between horizontal tabs
Activating a form control inside a modal must not close the modal
Tabbing past the last visible control of a modal must wrap inside the modal even when it contains hidden buttons
Ticking a 'None of these' checkbox must clear the other answers in its group even when each checkbox has its own name
ArrowLeft must keep moving the caret in other text fields while a calendar is shown
Form fields inside a disabled fieldset must not be treated as tabbable, so a focus-trapped dialog focuses its first usable field
Tabbing out of a date field with an out-of-range date must close the calendar
Pressing Tab in an open date field must move focus to the next form field
